methodology.scope: Offline analysis of saved v4 synthetic fixture batches. No model or browser calls.
methodology.grouping: Source revision, benchmark mode and input mode remain separate. All attempts retained, including failures and missing measurements.
methodology.timing: Use batch timing definitions. Planning may overlap initial navigation; runtime conditionWaitMs overlaps observationMs. These phases must not be added or subtracted as exclusive buckets.
methodology.cost: Unknown cost/usage stays unknown; known spend is reported separately. Jev values remain estimates where labeled. No zero-cost inference from a missing ledger.
methodology.sources: Internal consistency checks initial aggregate and initial/final per-file hashes; current checkout match is separate and may change after a valid historical run. This does not authenticate an external artifact.
